question: A cube of side 5 cm and a cuboid of measurements 35 cm,15 cm and 15 cm, respectively, of the same metal are melted and made into cubes of side 10 cm each. The number of cubes of side 10 cm thus formed is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Volume = Volume of **Cube** + Volume of **Cuboid**

Total Volume = 5³ + (35 × 15 × 15) = 125 + 7875 = 8000 cm³

Number of new cubes = Total Volume ÷ Volume of **New Cube**

Number of new cubes = 8000 ÷ 10³ = 8000 ÷ 1000 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the first **metal cube** (a₁) = 5 cm

Dimensions of the **metal cuboid** = 35 cm × 15 cm × 15 cm

Side of the **newly formed cubes** (a₂) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Cube = (Side)³

Volume of a Cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fb9fdddb54dcb06cfb62b9bec28dfb4738a0f58c14385bbc0ec8490a7f49269.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of small metal cube = 5 × 5 × 5 = 125 cm³

⇒ Volume of metal cuboid = 35 × 15 × 15 = 7875 cm³

⇒ Total volume of metal available = 125 + 7875 = 8000 cm³

⇒ Volume of one new cube = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000 cm³

⇒ Number of cubes = Total Volume ÷ Volume of one new cube

⇒ Number of cubes = 8000 ÷ 1000 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conservation of Volume

When one or more solid objects are **melted** and recast into new shapes, the total **volume remains constant**.

Cuboid Properties

Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl) and Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).

Cube Properties

Total Surface Area of cube = 6a² and Diagonal = a√3.</p
